rationale: Record that regrouping test executables crosses the visual-proof-harness selector without touching anything that family is about. The selector is crossed by test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake, which the family owns outright: its 92 Catch2 suites are rewritten from one executable each into four grouped executables (pulp-test-group-view-widgets, -inspector, -control-core, -control-executors) through pulp_add_test_suite(... GROUP ...), while process-isolation cases, including pulp-test-visual, stay standalone. Every ctest name and every per-test property (labels, timeouts, resource locks, environment, working directory) is preserved, verified by tools/scripts/ctest_inventory_parity.py against main with a declared map of 23 renamed duplicate case names. No screenshot, golden, capture, renderer, importer, DesignIR, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
